note: Cycle 1 scored 8.24 raw capped to 6.9 by one hard fail, primary text contrast under 4.5:1 on slides 03, 05 and 06. Slide 06's opaque copy plate covers the lower left and buries the near-ground micro octave the treatment argues from.

Slide 05's 'moving.' descender is tangent to the top edge of its body plate. Legible, cosmetic.
Slides 04 and 05 share one layout skeleton and are reorderable without loss.
